findings.passage: Temporarily removing guns from individuals in crisis can reduce the amount of deaths by firearm suicide.
findings.note: Her statement backing extreme risk protection order bills (posted by Urban Milwaukee as her own release).
subjects: limits on who may have a gun

findings.passage: We must act now to make our state safer for all, with common sense gun violence prevention laws and strong due process protections.
findings.note: Same statement: calls for gun violence prevention laws with due process protections.

findings.passage: In Wisconsin, we are working on gun violence prevention legislation such as ERPOs (Extreme Risk Protection Orders), universal background checks, and reinstating the 48-hour waiting period for firearm purchases.
findings.note: Release after the El Paso and Dayton shootings; she names three measures she backs.

findings.passage: We can honor our Wisconsin heritage of outdoor sportsmanship, protect human life, and preserve constitutional rights surrounding gun ownership, and so we should.
findings.note: Same release: says gun laws and gun ownership rights can both be kept.
subjects: gun rights and gun safety laws together

findings.passage: We must pass universal background checks and Extreme Risk Protection Order (ERPO) legislation to help combat this crisis.
findings.note: Release on co-authoring the 2021 extreme risk order and universal background check bills.

findings.passage: I co-authored four bills that, if signed into law, will decrease gun violence and save lives:
findings.note: Introduces her list of four bills (the next lines in the release name them: LRB-0827 background checks on all gun purchases; LRB-0829 reinstates the 48-hour waiting period; LRB-1598 extreme risk protection order; LRB-3342 bans untraceable ghost guns).
Her release lists this co-authored draft bill (co-authorship; LegiScan bulk check holds the bill numbers).
